title: Salary stitch-up? Thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers protest for pay hike - South China Morning Post
text:
Tempers fray as thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers protest for pay hike | South China Morning Post South Asia - South Asia Salary stitch-up? Thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers protest for pay hike Advertisement Bangladesh Asia South Asia Tempers fray as thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers protest for pay hike 
 About 4 million people work in Bangladesh’s garment sector, which accounts for more than 80 per cent of its export earnings
 2 -MIN READ 2 -MIN Listen Agence France-Presse Published: 3:29pm, 2 Nov 2026 Updated: 3:35pm, 2 Nov 2026 Thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers blocked a major highway and clashed with police on Monday, demanding a monthly minimum wage more than double current pay, as protests spread across industrial hubs.
 Bangladesh is the world’s second-biggest garment exporter behind China, manufacturing clothes for some of the largest international brands. Hundreds of workers in Gazipur, north of the capital Dhaka, blocked the Dhaka-Tangail highway, vandalising several vehicles, while large groups took to the streets in the Mirpur district, where police dispersed demonstrators with tear gas.
